title: A Probabilistic Proof of a Positivstellensatz of Baldi-Sinn-Telek-Weigert
summary: The AI gives a probabilistic proof of a uniform-denominator Positivstellensatz of Baldi--Sinn--Telek--Weigert for Laurent polynomials whose induced homogeneous form is strictly positive on the nonnegative part of a projective toric variety. Only this abstract was human-written.
